page.layout: One printed title page, one column of centred lines with a woodcut device in the middle; manuscript annotations in the top right corner and at the left edge are not printed text.
page.notes: The woodcut device between the title and the imprint shows a star over a city within a scroll-work frame, with the legend "IMPERAT" on the left, "ASTRIS" on the right and "DEUS" below; it is not transcribed as text. Handwritten pencil or ink marks in the top right corner (a shelf or press note) and at the left edge are not printed and are left out.
